contributions.anchor: Column A 'Total this Period' TOTAL CONTRIBUTIONS RECEIVED ($13,850.00) on the p2 Summary Page, which is also Schedule A's own printed 'Subtotal for this page' ($13,850.00) and its printed 'Total Contributions Received' ($13,850.00)
contributions.detail: 10 Schedule A rows sum to 1000.00 + 2500.00 + 500.00 + 2000.00 + 100.00 + 500.00 + 250.00 + 2500.00 + 2500.00 + 2000.00 = 13,850.00 exactly = the printed page subtotal = the printed total = the cover's PROMOTED per-period cell Column A. Column B 'Year-to-Date Total' prints $39,998.25 and is NOT summed as an increment (it is the cycle running total, and it happens to equal this period's 13,850.00 plus the June report's 26,148.25 - an observation, never an input).

expenditures.anchor: Column A 'Total this Period' TOTAL EXPENDITURES MADE ($15,360.99) on the p2 Summary Page, equal to the handwritten 'Total Expenditures Received' written on each of the three Schedule B pages (15,360.99)
expenditures.detail: 47 rows across the three Schedule B pages sum to 15,360.99 exactly = the cover's Column A. THE PAGE-SUBTOTAL GATE CLOSES THREE TIMES INDEPENDENTLY: p4's 17 rows sum to 8,852.77 = its printed 'Subtotal for this page'; p5's 17 rows sum to 5,245.83 = its printed subtotal; p6's 13 rows sum to 1,262.39 = its printed subtotal; and 8,852.77 + 5,245.83 + 1,262.39 = 15,360.99. Column B YTD $36,910.11 is retained as cumulative and never summed.
